queries.title: Membership plan catalog
queries.purpose: List every plan with its term, price and monthly cost, cheapest first, so staff can quote prices to new members.
queries.sql:
SELECT PlanID,
       PlanName,
       DurationMonths,
       Price,
       ROUND(Price / DurationMonths, 2) AS PricePerMonth
FROM MembershipPlan
ORDER BY Price;

queries.title: Member directory with plan (INNER JOIN)
queries.purpose: Show each member's name, age, experience level and the plan they are enrolled in, ordered by last name.
queries.sql:
SELECT m.MemberID,
       m.FirstName,
       m.LastName,
       m.Age,
       m.ExperienceLevel,
       p.PlanName
FROM Member m
JOIN MembershipPlan p ON p.PlanID = m.PlanID
ORDER BY m.LastName, m.FirstName, m.MemberID
LIMIT 15;

queries.title: Top 10 calorie-burning sessions (3-table JOIN)
queries.purpose: Identify the most intense sessions with member and workout type, for a "top performers" board.
queries.sql:
SELECT s.SessionID,
       CONCAT(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName) AS MemberName,
       t.TypeName      AS WorkoutType,
       s.SessionDate,
       s.DurationHours,
       s.CaloriesBurned
FROM WorkoutSession s
JOIN Member m      ON m.MemberID = s.MemberID
JOIN WorkoutType t ON t.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID
ORDER BY s.CaloriesBurned DESC, s.SessionID
LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Expert members on the Premium plan (multi-condition filter)
queries.purpose: Target list for an advanced training program: experts on the Premium plan who train at least 4 days per week.
queries.sql:
SELECT m.MemberID,
       m.FirstName,
       m.LastName,
       m.Gender,
       m.WorkoutFrequency
FROM Member m
JOIN MembershipPlan p ON p.PlanID = m.PlanID
WHERE p.PlanName = 'Premium'
  AND m.ExperienceLevel = 'Expert'
  AND m.WorkoutFrequency >= 4
ORDER BY m.WorkoutFrequency DESC, m.LastName, m.MemberID;

queries.title: Long HIIT / Strength sessions in Q1 2025 (IN, BETWEEN filters)
queries.purpose: Find high-effort sessions (over 1.5 hours) of HIIT or Strength held January to March 2025, newest first.
queries.sql:
SELECT s.SessionID,
       m.FirstName,
       m.LastName,
       t.TypeName,
       s.SessionDate,
       s.DurationHours,
       s.MaxBPM
FROM WorkoutSession s
JOIN Member m      ON m.MemberID = s.MemberID
JOIN WorkoutType t ON t.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID
WHERE t.TypeName IN ('HIIT', 'Strength')
  AND s.SessionDate BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  AND s.DurationHours > 1.5
ORDER BY s.SessionDate DESC, s.SessionID;

queries.title: Members at health risk (filter on derived BMI)
queries.purpose: Flag members with BMI of 30 or more (obese range) together with their body-fat reading so trainers can follow up.
queries.sql:
SELECT m.MemberID,
       m.FirstName,
       m.LastName,
       m.Age,
       m.BMI,
       s.FatPercentage
FROM Member m
JOIN WorkoutSession s ON s.MemberID = m.MemberID
WHERE m.BMI >= 30
ORDER BY m.BMI DESC, m.MemberID
LIMIT 15;

queries.title: Members with no sessions logged (LEFT JOIN + IS NULL)
queries.purpose: Find inactive members for re-engagement campaigns. A newly enrolled member is inserted first (only once, so the pack can be re-run) to demonstrate the result.
queries.sql:
INSERT INTO Member (FirstName, LastName, Age, Gender, HeightM, WeightKg, BMI,
                    ExperienceLevel, WorkoutFrequency, PlanID)
SELECT 'Jordan', 'Reyes', 27, 'Other', 1.75, 70.00, 22.86, 'Beginner', 3, 1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member WHERE FirstName = 'Jordan' AND LastName = 'Reyes');

SELECT m.MemberID,
       m.FirstName,
       m.LastName,
       p.PlanName
FROM Member m
JOIN MembershipPlan p      ON p.PlanID = m.PlanID
LEFT JOIN WorkoutSession s ON s.MemberID = m.MemberID
WHERE s.SessionID IS NULL;

queries.title: Workout type performance (GROUP BY + HAVING)
queries.purpose: Compare session count, average duration, calories and heart rate per workout type; keep types averaging > 900 kcal.
queries.sql:
SELECT t.TypeName,
       COUNT(*)                          AS Sessions,
       ROUND(AVG(s.DurationHours), 2)    AS AvgHours,
       ROUND(AVG(s.CaloriesBurned), 0)   AS AvgCalories,
       ROUND(AVG(s.AvgBPM), 0)           AS AvgHeartRate
FROM WorkoutSession s
JOIN WorkoutType t ON t.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID
GROUP BY t.TypeName
HAVING AVG(s.CaloriesBurned) > 900
ORDER BY AvgCalories DESC;

queries.title: Plan revenue and engagement (GROUP BY + HAVING)
queries.purpose: For each plan, count members, total subscription revenue and average weekly frequency; show plans with more than 200 members.
queries.sql:
SELECT p.PlanName,
       COUNT(m.MemberID)                 AS Members,
       SUM(p.Price)                      AS TotalRevenue,
       ROUND(AVG(m.WorkoutFrequency), 2) AS AvgDaysPerWeek
FROM MembershipPlan p
JOIN Member m ON m.PlanID = p.PlanID
GROUP BY p.PlanID, p.PlanName
HAVING COUNT(m.MemberID) > 200
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

queries.title: Outcomes by experience level and gender (multi-column GROUP BY)
queries.purpose: Compare body fat, water intake and calories across experience levels and gender; only groups with at least 50 members.
queries.sql:
SELECT m.ExperienceLevel,
       m.Gender,
       COUNT(*)                          AS Members,
       ROUND(AVG(s.FatPercentage), 2)    AS AvgFatPct,
       ROUND(AVG(s.WaterIntakeLiters),2) AS AvgWaterL,
       ROUND(AVG(s.CaloriesBurned), 0)   AS AvgCalories
FROM Member m
JOIN WorkoutSession s ON s.MemberID = m.MemberID
GROUP BY m.ExperienceLevel, m.Gender
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY FIELD(m.ExperienceLevel, 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Expert'), m.Gender;

queries.title: Sessions above the overall average (scalar subquery)
queries.purpose: Count, per workout type, how many sessions burned more calories than the gym-wide average session.
queries.sql:
SELECT t.TypeName,
       COUNT(*) AS AboveAvgSessions
FROM WorkoutSession s
JOIN WorkoutType t ON t.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID
WHERE s.CaloriesBurned > (SELECT AVG(CaloriesBurned) FROM WorkoutSession)
GROUP BY t.TypeName
ORDER BY AboveAvgSessions DESC;

queries.title: Top performer within each workout type (correlated subquery)
queries.purpose: For every workout type, return the member(s) whose session burned the most calories in that type.
queries.sql:
SELECT t.TypeName,
       CONCAT(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName) AS MemberName,
       m.ExperienceLevel,
       s.CaloriesBurned
FROM WorkoutSession s
JOIN Member m      ON m.MemberID = s.MemberID
JOIN WorkoutType t ON t.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID
WHERE s.CaloriesBurned = (SELECT MAX(s2.CaloriesBurned)
                          FROM WorkoutSession s2
                          WHERE s2.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID)
ORDER BY s.CaloriesBurned DESC, MemberName;

queries.title: Members more consistent than their plan average (IN + derived table)
queries.purpose: Find members whose weekly frequency beats the average of their own plan, then summarize how many per plan.
queries.sql:
SELECT p.PlanName,
       COUNT(*) AS AboveAvgMembers
FROM Member m
JOIN MembershipPlan p ON p.PlanID = m.PlanID
JOIN (SELECT PlanID, AVG(WorkoutFrequency) AS PlanAvg
      FROM Member
      GROUP BY PlanID) pa ON pa.PlanID = m.PlanID
WHERE m.WorkoutFrequency > pa.PlanAvg
  AND m.MemberID IN (SELECT MemberID FROM WorkoutSession)
GROUP BY p.PlanName
ORDER BY AboveAvgMembers DESC;

queries.title: Monthly activity trend with running total (CTE + window function)
queries.purpose: Sessions and calories per month in 2025 with a cumulative session count, to plan class schedules from real demand.
queries.sql:
WITH Monthly AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(SessionDate, '%Y-%m') AS YearMonth,
           COUNT(*)                          AS Sessions,
           SUM(CaloriesBurned)               AS TotalCalories
    FROM WorkoutSession
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(SessionDate, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT YearMonth,
       Sessions,
       TotalCalories,
       SUM(Sessions) OVER (ORDER BY YearMonth) AS RunningSessions
FROM Monthly
ORDER BY YearMonth;

queries.title: Rank members within experience level (RANK window function)
queries.purpose: Top 3 members per experience level by calories burned per hour of training (efficiency).
queries.sql:
SELECT ExperienceLevel, MemberName, CaloriesPerHour, LevelRank
FROM (
    SELECT m.ExperienceLevel,
           CONCAT(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName)              AS MemberName,
           ROUND(s.CaloriesBurned / s.DurationHours, 1)      AS CaloriesPerHour,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.ExperienceLevel
                        ORDER BY s.CaloriesBurned / s.DurationHours DESC) AS LevelRank
    FROM Member m
    JOIN WorkoutSession s ON s.MemberID = m.MemberID
) ranked
WHERE LevelRank <= 3
ORDER BY FIELD(ExperienceLevel, 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Expert'), LevelRank, MemberName;

queries.title: Reusable member dashboard (VIEW + CASE)
queries.purpose: A view joining all four tables with a BMI category, used by the Phase 4 frontend; then query it by plan and BMI category.
queries.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_MemberDashboard AS
SELECT m.MemberID,
       CONCAT(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName) AS MemberName,
       m.Age,
       m.Gender,
       m.ExperienceLevel,
       p.PlanName,
       t.TypeName AS WorkoutType,
       s.SessionDate,
       s.CaloriesBurned,
       m.BMI,
       CASE WHEN m.BMI < 18.5 THEN 'Underweight'
            WHEN m.BMI < 25   THEN 'Normal'
            WHEN m.BMI < 30   THEN 'Overweight'
            ELSE 'Obese' END AS BMICategory
FROM Member m
JOIN MembershipPlan p ON p.PlanID = m.PlanID
JOIN WorkoutSession s ON s.MemberID = m.MemberID
JOIN WorkoutType t    ON t.WorkoutTypeID = s.WorkoutTypeID;

SELECT PlanName,
       BMICategory,
       COUNT(*)                     AS Members,
       ROUND(AVG(CaloriesBurned),0) AS AvgCalories
FROM vw_MemberDashboard
GROUP BY PlanName, BMICategory
ORDER BY FIELD(PlanName, 'Basic', 'Standard', 'Premium'),
         FIELD(BMICategory, 'Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese');
